Apr 2025 • Family

Birthday Night
Feb 2023 • Friends
- Location: located in Thao Dien area of District 2, the restaurant is located at the front, sometimes there will be traffic jams due to many cars parking or stopping to drop off customers.
- Space: Not as large as I thought, just the garden area outside, but I haven't figured out what the house is inside. The virtual living area is the swimming pool, you will have luxurious photos with a tropical style. The restaurant is suitable for birthdays and dates because of its luxurious space.
- The dining area and bar are covered and on the side so there will be no fear of heavy rain coming in. As for the tables serving guests drinking cocktails near the pool, there are only large umbrellas to protect them from the sun and rain.
- Food: fine dining style so portions are small. Delicious food, served with free appetizers like bread and butter.
- Price: appetizers from 150k, main dishes from 250k, soft drinks from 70k. Invoice will add 10% VAT.
